Description: Any authenticated request with invalid input terminated the whole server process (Zod 4 exposes issues, not errors; src/server/api.ts, 3 call sites). Found by OQ-03 strict-schema test. Denial of service and possible loss of in-flight work.
Correction / action: Corrected to parseResult.error.issues; OQ re-run 28/28 pass.

Description: Seed script aborted: OOS record referenced non-existent sample SMP-2026-003.
Correction / action: Corrected to SMP-2026-00003; seed completes.

Description: URS-050: no backup/restore function existed in the application.
Correction / action: Implemented encrypted verified backup and restore (src/server/backup.ts); OQ-09 12/12 pass. Residual items tracked as DEV-08.

Description: Non-core modules (ELN, OOS, stability, environmental, reagents, instruments, training, reports, barcode, voice) have no OQ coverage.
Correction / action: Release R2: OQ-10 to OQ-30 now execute automated tests for master data, methods, results, raw data, instruments, the machine API, events, certificates, OOS, quality records, documents and training, custody, reagents, stability, environmental monitoring, worklists and turnaround. ELN, the AI assistant, voice input and the camera scanner still have none. A module can now be declared NotQualified (writes refused) or Qualified by QA with an e-signature (validated-scope register, URS-116); see DEV-2026-10-25-04.

Description: PQ by representative end users has not been performed; PQ evidence is technical/automated only.
Correction / action: Schedule end-user PQ per PQ-01/PQ-02 scripts.

Description: IQ and the installer were executed only in a Linux development sandbox. Windows installer (NSIS), DPAPI protection and the target PC were not tested.
Correction / action: Execute IQ-W on the target PC; build installer on Windows or CI.

Description: URS-043 (offline operation) and the same-transaction audit property across all modules are supported by code reading only (P*). URS-005, -006, -012 were initially P* and are now covered by OQ-08 executed tests.
Correction / action: Add an offline-run test and audit-in-transaction tests per module when modules are qualified (DEV-04).

Description: Backups are manual: no automatic schedule, no automatic copy to a server share, no restore-test SOP, and the passphrase custody is procedural.
Correction / action: Write SOPs (backup, passphrase custody, quarterly restore test); consider a scheduler in a later release.

Description: Browser flows (tests/e2e) run against the built bundle on Linux with Chromium only. They do not cover the Electron window, Windows, or the Arabic-locale clock; the ELN, the AI assistant and voice input have no flow and no OQ.
Correction / action: Run the flows in the Windows CI job (DEV-06) and add ELN, AI and voice flows when those modules are qualified.

Description: The shell OQ (tests/security-controls.sh) was not retired and replaced by a Vitest suite: it still drives the built bundle with curl, which is the only OQ evidence that runs against the shipped server.
Correction / action: Keep both; port its checks to Vitest only if a bundle-level run is added to CI another way.

Description: URS-041 (secrets protected by the operating-system store) has no executed test on Windows; the Linux run used the plain-text backend. It is a Critical/High requirement carried by an open deviation instead of a passed test.
Correction / action: Execute IQ-W/PQ-02 on the target PC (see DEV-2026-10-13-06).

Description: Qualification status of the 15 catalogued modules is undeclared at installation: the register is empty, so no module is blocked. This package does not declare any module Qualified; that is a QA decision with an electronic signature.
Correction / action: QA reviews the OQ-10 to OQ-30 evidence and declares each module (Validation, qualified_modules).

Description: Writes that do not arrive as an HTTP request to the catalogued paths (scheduler and job handlers, the instrument folder agent, /api/v1 tokens) are not stopped by the NotQualified guard.
Correction / action: Decide per module whether the background writers must also read the register.

Description: Accessibility: axe-core finds serious or critical violations on 13 of the 28 screens scanned on the combined R2 tree (select-name and button-name without an accessible name, aria-allowed-attr on the dashboard tiles, color-contrast, definition-list, scrollable-region-focusable, label-title-only). r2-ui-foundation reported 0 on 8 screens; later tracks introduced the findings. The screens belong to the tracks that built them.
Correction / action: tests/a11y/baseline.json lists every finding; the gate fails on a new one and forces the removal of a fixed one. Owners fix the screens (needsFromOtherTracks).

Description: tests/client-shell.cjs (r1-client-shell) has two stale checks on the R2 tree: A5 reads the header title before the hash router has updated it, and C11 to C14 drive the result-correction form that the result workbench replaced. The script is not owned by this track.
Correction / action: The owner updates the script; tests/e2e/known-failures.json lists both and forces their removal once they pass. The lock over an unsaved form (C1 to C10), the idle timer, session expiry and forced password change still pass.

Description: tests/desktop-smoke.cjs (r1-build-shell) stops at the first-run screen on the R2 tree: it does not supply the first administrator (ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_NAME, ADMIN_PASSWORD) that the installer now requires, so it prints no result line. It is not used as evidence any more; desktop-shell.cjs and desktop-upgrade.cjs (25 checks) pass and carry URS-040 to URS-042.
Correction / action: The owner updates the smoke script or retires it; the first-run path itself is exercised by desktop-upgrade.cjs.

Description: The Windows installer was installed and started only on the GitHub Windows runner (tests/installer/gui-smoke.ps1: SERVER_START, no SYSTEM_INTEGRITY_FAIL). Nothing past the integrity stage (setup screen, database connection, sign-in) was run on Windows, and no validation PC was used.
Correction / action: Execute IQ-W and PQ on the target PC; extend the smoke test past sign-in.

Description: The built-in PostgreSQL is not in the installer: desktop/pg-bundle.json has no SHA-256, so desktop/pg-fetch.cjs refuses to download it. The supervisor and the first-run flow are tested on Linux only (OQ-37); Windows binaries, icacls and DPAPI are not.
Correction / action: Pin the SHA-256 of the vendor zip, add the fetch to the build, rebuild and re-run OQ-37 and IQ-W on Windows.

Description: Directory sign-on was tested against a fake directory behind the connector seam and against a real TLS socket, never against a real Active Directory (certificate trust, attribute names, group attribute).
Correction / action: First IQ run against the customer domain controllers; record the attributes used.

Description: No release signing key and no Authenticode certificate exist; the manifest is written unsigned (hashes only) and the installer is unsigned. The audit-gate waivers have a blank approver.
Correction / action: QA/IT generate and custody the Ed25519 release key and the code-signing certificate; QA approves or removes each waiver.

Description: The Arabic catalogue is a machine-assisted DRAFT; only its structure is tested (URS-139). The 25 environmental-monitoring limit profiles are Draft.
Correction / action: QA and a linguistic reviewer approve the Arabic wording; QA approves the limit profiles with an e-signature.

Description: The first-load bundle is 696 KB of the 700 KB budget (tests/perf/bundle.cjs), so one more shared import may fail the build.
Correction / action: Lazy-load the Arabic catalogue to regain headroom.

Description: The script tests/installer/silent-install.ps1 (silent install, database boot check) did not finish within 12 minutes on its first Windows run; it is now informative only (continue-on-error, 8 minutes) and is not evidence.
Correction / action: Find why the database boot check hangs and make it blocking again.

Description: The browser accessibility run of 2026-10-26 reports a color-contrast violation (serious, 6 nodes in table headers) on the quality management screen. The wave-9 gate had removed that entry from tests/a11y/baseline.json as stale (three clean runs); it appears again, so the finding is intermittent or depends on the data. It is the one FAIL of 217 browser checks. DEV-2026-10-25-06 (13 of 28 screens) stays open.
Correction / action: Fix the header contrast on the quality management table, or restore the baseline entry with a justification, and find why it varies between runs.

Description: The CI workflow tests failed (run 5, commit 8fe69ea) although all 2181 tests passed: an unhandled pg connection error (57P01, terminating connection due to administrator command) was reported against tests/api/backup-runs.test.ts. The scratch pool of the restore drill is dropped WITH (FORCE). The race did not reproduce locally (10 of 10 tests pass, twice).
Correction / action: src/server/jobs/backupService.ts now handles the error event of the scratch pool. Confirm by a green tests run in CI; reopen if the error returns.
